body: P2. cps/api/auth.py:299-301 and325-326 return after LDAP success without _clear_current_rate_limits, unlike local login at340. Real Flask API with memory-backed limiter and successful LDAP responses returned [200,200,200,429] for four correct logins. Declared40/day bucket is affected by same missing reset, not separately time-tested. Preserve failed-bind throttling while clearing evaluated buckets after LDAP success. Seen with existing directory user; prospective new-user success path shares omission. Audit2026-09-08 main1ec1bfe677.

resolution.note: Both LDAP success exits clear evaluated failure buckets. Real limiter regression uses failures before/after provisioning, 42 successful logins, and failed-bind throttling. Seen red on base and with only the new-user reset removed; 63 auth tests pass restored. Not released.

title: Successful LDAP sign-ins exhaust SPA failure rate limits
